article.info_title: The next step in Bing generative search
article.info_description: In July, we introduced an early view of generative search in Bing, and today we’re taking the next step as we continue to evolve our vision of the future of search. With the introduction of generative search, Bing utilizes AI to deliver a truly unique experience by not only optimizing the search results but also how those results appear in a cohesive layout. This transformation is more than aesthetic; it’s about creating a seamless experience that empowers you to explore, learn, and find information in new ways.

article.info_title: IndexNow: When and How Websites Should Notify Search Engines
article.info_description: Leaving your content's visibility in search engines to chance is like throwing a party and forgetting to send out the invitations! Learn when and how to update IndexNow to make sure your content gets the spotlight it deserves and stays visible in search results when it matters most.

article.info_title: Learn all about Google Trends with our new YouTube tutorials
article.info_description:
This post is about the new Google Trends Tutorials YouTube series. In these videos you'll learn how to use
      Google Trends to analyze patterns in Google Search and Youtube searches, and use them to create
      interesting content online.

We now surface a recommendation to fix misconfigured deep links in your app if you have an app data stream, and your app has misconfigured App Links or Universal Links (i.e., the links are not successfully directing mobile users to the mobile app when they have the app installed).

We've fixed an issue that caused over-attribution of sessions to Direct, either when enabling enhanced user ID mode with automatic user data collection, or starting in late June to mid July for customers already using the feature before that date.

You can now create and manage multiple sources for each data import type, giving you greater flexibility and ability to handle complex data scenarios for your data import needs. Data imports will also keep your existing data intact while new data is seamlessly added or updated to avoid accidental overwrites.

article.info_title: Vehicle ads have become available to advertisers in the United Kingdom
article.info_description:
Effective October 2024, vehicle ads will be available to all United Kingdom advertisers and will be expanded to more countries at a later date.
Vehicle ads are a performance focused, omnichannel, lower funnel ad format which allows auto advertisers to promote their entire inventory to interested customers shopping for vehicles on Google.com.
